map.过流能力分管道与明渠两类：管道按断面面积乘平均流速 Q = A·v；明渠按曼宁公: Discharge capacity has two types: pipe by cross-sectional area times average velocity Q = A*v; open channel by Manning formula, first from bottom width b, water depth h and side slope coefficient m find flow area A and wetted perimeter P, get hydraulic radius R = A/P, then multiply by reciprocal of roughness and square root of bed slope for flow. Side slope coefficient m = 0 is rectangular section, commonly used for irrigation channels and drains discharge capacity estimation.
